upstream_sources: retail-rates-us-en.pdf — UPS Retail Rate and Service Guide (effective 2026-09-07), Value-Added Services and Other Charges

pickup_options.name: UPS Smart Pickup®
pickup_options.description: Automatically arrange a pickup only when you have packages to ship. A UPS driver will attempt a pickup the same business day when a package is tendered before a predetermined cut-off time. Pickups typically occur after 1:30 p.m.

pickup_options.name: Daily Pickup
pickup_options.description: A UPS driver attempts a pickup at your location once each business day as scheduled, typically after 2:00 p.m.

pickup_options.name: Day-Specific Pickup
pickup_options.description: Select which days of the week, Monday through Friday, you would like UPS to attempt a Scheduled Pickup. UPS will only stop at your location those days as scheduled, typically after 2:00 p.m.

pickup_options.name: Daily On-Route Pickup
pickup_options.description: A UPS driver attempts a pickup at your location once each business day while making deliveries in your area. Pickups typically occur between 10:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m.

pickup_options.name: UPS On-Call Pickup® (Future-Day)
pickup_options.description: With one pickup request, UPS will pick up all of your packages at a location of your choosing. Fees are applied per pickup request regardless of the number of packages being picked up.

pickup_options.name: UPS On-Call Pickup® (Same-Day)
pickup_options.description: Schedule a same-day pickup via ups.com or by calling 1-800-PICK-UPS (1-800-742-5877).

saturday_options.name: Saturday Stop Charge (Scheduled Pickup)
saturday_options.description: Your Saturday pickup type must match your Monday through Friday pickup type; fee applies any time a Saturday pickup is requested, in addition to weekly Scheduled Pickup fees.

saturday_options.name: Saturday Pickup (UPS Smart Pickup®)
saturday_options.description: A UPS driver attempts a pickup at your location when you process a shipment on Saturday in an eligible shipping system before a predetermined cut-off time.

saturday_options.name: Saturday Pickup (UPS On-Call Pickup®)
saturday_options.description: A UPS driver attempts a pickup at your location when you schedule a one-time Saturday pickup via ups.com on or prior to Saturday. This Saturday Stop Charge applies in addition to the applicable UPS On-Call Pickup Charge.

delivery_options.name: Signature Required
delivery_options.description: UPS will obtain a signature upon delivery. UPS may obtain, at its discretion, an electronic authorization to release the package without a signature on delivery.

delivery_options.name: Adult Signature Required
delivery_options.description: UPS will obtain an adult recipient's signature upon delivery. Adult recipients must be at least 21 years old (government-issued photo ID required for delivery).

delivery_options.name: Hold at Location
delivery_options.description: The shipper may request that UPS hold a shipment at a UPS location for pickup.

delivery_options.name: Ship to a UPS Access Point® Location
delivery_options.description: For the convenience of recipients, shippers can send packages directly to a UPS Access Point Location. Recipients will be notified by email when their packages arrive.

other_services.name: Declared Value for Carriage
other_services.description: UPS's liability for loss or damage for each domestic package is limited to $100.00 without a declaration of value. Example from the Rate Guide: a declaration of $950.00 value incurs a charge of $17.00 (10 times $1.70).

other_services.name: UPS Delivery Intercept® (Web/Electronic)
other_services.description: As the shipper, request that UPS return the package to you, reroute it to a new address, or reschedule its delivery to a future date.

other_services.name: UPS Delivery Intercept® (Phone)
other_services.description: A UPS Delivery Intercept request made by calling 1-800-PICK-UPS (1-800-742-5877).

notes: Fuel surcharges may apply to any or all domestic and international transportation charges and certain accessorial charges; for current fuel surcharges visit ups.com/fuelsurcharge.
Effective 2026-09-07, the UPS Rate and Service Guides were updated.

Effective 2026-09-27 through 2026-11-21, a Demand Surcharge of $8.75 per package applies to Additional Handling packages; $11.90 per package from 2026-11-22 through 2026-12-26 (demand-surcharges-us-en.pdf).
